comment: Trimmed: descriptive text dropped; official prices kept only where the model page shows them.

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking can be turned off only at effort high or lower.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 只有 effort 为 high 或更低时才能关闭思考。

caveat.en: Forcing a tool with tool_choice any or tool returns an error.
caveat.zh-CN: 用 tool_choice 的 any 或 tool 强制调用工具会报错。

caveat.en: Anthropic's safety classifiers on this model can decline a request.
caveat.zh-CN: 本模型带 Anthropic 的安全分类器，可能拒绝某些请求。

caveat.en: xAI retires this model on November 2, 2026; its requests then run on grok-imagine-image-2.0 at quality low.
caveat.zh-CN: xAI 将于 2026 年 11 月 2 日下线本模型，此后请求改由 grok-imagine-image-2.0 以 low 质量出图。

caveat.en: Forcing a tool with tool_choice any or tool returns an error.
caveat.zh-CN: 用 tool_choice 的 any 或 tool 强制调用工具会报错。

caveat.en: temperature, top_p and top_k must stay at their defaults: any other value returns 400.
caveat.zh-CN: temperature、top_p、top_k 只能用默认值，传其他值返回 400。

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking cannot be turned off: thinking.type disabled and reasoning_effort none are both ignored.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 思考关不掉：thinking.type disabled 和 reasoning_effort none 都会被忽略。

items.note_en: Weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time are billed at twice these rates.

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking is on by default; reasoning_effort none turns it off, thinking.type disabled does not.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 默认开启思考；传 reasoning_effort none 可以关闭，传 thinking.type disabled 不起作用。

items.note_en: Weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time are billed at twice these rates.

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking is on by default; reasoning_effort none turns it off, thinking.type disabled does not.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 默认开启思考；传 reasoning_effort none 可以关闭，传 thinking.type disabled 不起作用。

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking is on by default; reasoning_effort none turns it off, thinking.type disabled does not.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 默认开启思考；传 reasoning_effort none 可以关闭，传 thinking.type disabled 不起作用。

caveat.en: In Chat Completions it calls functions only with reasoning_effort none; for tools with reasoning, use the Responses API.
caveat.zh-CN: 在 Chat Completions 中只有 reasoning_effort 为 none 时才能调用函数；需要边推理边调用工具时请用 Responses API。

caveat.en: Use the Responses API for tool calling. Chat Completions supports this model without tools; none and minimal reasoning efforts are not supported.
caveat.zh-CN: 需要调用工具时请使用 Responses API；Chat Completions 支持该模型但不支持工具调用。该模型不支持 none 和 minimal 推理强度。

reasoning_rule.en: Thinking is off by default; reasoning_effort low, medium, high or xhigh turns it on. max is refused, and thinking.type has no effect.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 默认不思考；传 reasoning_effort 为 low、medium、high 或 xhigh 会开启思考。max 会被拒绝，thinking.type 不起作用。

reasoning_rule.en: It has no effort levels: leave reasoning_effort and thinking out.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 它没有推理强度档位：不要传 reasoning_effort 和 thinking。

reasoning_rule.en: Pick the effort on the first turn: changing it mid-conversation throws away the cached prefix.
reasoning_rule.zh-CN: 在第一轮就选定 effort：对话中途更换会让已缓存的前缀失效。

caveat.en: Send images as base64 data URLs: public image URLs are not accepted.
caveat.zh-CN: 图片要用 base64 data URL 发送：不接受公网图片链接。
